precedence: This override supersedes conflicting or incomplete statements about ordinary Student Login Manager batch selection/provisioning only. All non-conflicting Portal V2, Replace Resource and shared-Worker composition authority remains binding.

change.name: Create new batch from existing batch settings
change.baselineCommitMessage: Add Admin facility to create new student batches

requiredBehaviour.batchKeyRule: Canonicalise to uppercase and validate before mutation.
requiredBehaviour.templateRule: The selected existing batch is the settings template; the new batch remains a distinct batch key.
requiredBehaviour.activeFromRule: Use the requested activeFrom date for the new batch rather than silently inheriting the template's start date.
requiredBehaviour.postCreateUi: Refresh active batches, select the newly created batch for the student when it becomes available, and preserve existing Student Login Manager provisioning flow.
requiredBehaviour.dropdownPresentation: In Copy settings from, render at least one visible space between the batch code and its human-readable type/description so values such as Y411OE and Year 4 / 11+ English do not run together.

safetyAndPreservation: Do not mutate an existing batch definition when creating a new batch.
Do not create or modify a student merely by creating the batch definition.
Do not claim a requested batch or student exists until the authenticated mutation and readback complete.
Do not alter normal-student multi-device session semantics.
Do not alter Trial one-successful-login semantics.
Do not alter lesson release, prepared access projection, protected Answer Pack, PreLesson/VR or quiz-bridge behaviour.
Shared Worker production deployment must retain the composed quiz bridge -> Admin Tools chain and all existing preservation gates.

completionBoundary.engineeringChange: Repository implementation is present on main at c043e065b28f458689c9278fa4bf9d4ee6cee1a4; later UI-spacing hardening may be merged separately.
completionBoundary.productionMutation: A particular new batch is not considered created until the Admin API mutation succeeds and the new batch is observed in the refreshed active-batch list.
completionBoundary.studentProvisioning: A student login is not considered provisioned until the existing create-student transaction and its prepared access publication/readback gates succeed.

verificationMatrix: Verify unauthenticated batch creation remains rejected.
Verify invalid/duplicate batch keys fail closed.
Verify a valid batch is copied from the intended template with the requested activeFrom date.
Verify the Admin dropdown displays a visible separator space between batch code and description.
After any shared Worker production deploy, rerun the existing shared-capability regression gates.
authorityUpdateRule: If batch-definition fields, endpoint shape, template-copy semantics, provisioning coupling, or validation rules change, update this override and GCH_CURRENT.json in the same coherent change.
